deadline.value: Closing dates are on the course page's How to apply tab, which was blocked; the University says some faculties consider applications at any time and others at fixed times of the year.

gre_subject.value: Not mentioned on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: You must have the endorsement of a prospective supervisor to be considered; contact one through their Find an Expert profile before applying.
supervisor.quote: have obtained the endorsement of a prospective supervisor

also.quote: Send a prospective supervisor a message on their Find an Expert profile and explain what you'd like to do.

funding.value: You are automatically considered for a Graduate Research Scholarship (stipend AUD 41,100 a year in 2027 and/or tuition fee remission); these go to the highest-ranked applicants, and without a fee scholarship you may be offered a full fee-paying place.
funding.quote: If eligible, you'll automatically be considered for a Graduate Research Scholarship that provides a living allowance and/or tuition fee remission scholarship. More than 300 of these scholarships are offered to international graduate researchers each year. | If you're unsuccessful in gaining a tuition fee remission scholarship, you may be offered a place as a full fee-paying student.

also.quote: A fortnightly stipend with a rate of $41,100 per year pro rata (2027 full-time rate) for up to two years for students undertaking a Masters by Research degree or up to 3.5 years for students undertaking a doctoral degree. | The Melbourne Research Scholarship is offered to students who are ranked highest by relevant selection panels

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's with a research component of at least 25% of a full-time year and a final-year average of at least 75%, or a master's with such a research component and a 75% average.
entry_route.quote: a four-year Bachelor degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component equivalent to at least 25% of one year of full-time study and have achieved a minimum weighted average of 75% in the final year subjects or (University of Melbourne) equivalent; or | a Masters degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component equivalent to at least 25% of one year of full-time study and achieved a minimum weighted average of 75% or (University of Melbourne) equivalent

notes: PhD (Science), course code DR-PHILSCI, 4 years full time, offered in the School of Mathematics and Statistics; the school's own pages were blocked (Cloudflare), so course-level Handbook rules are used.
